Portal RT edits reset per-conn prop!
1. First Route Map triggers a one-time ~30-min vHub router & gateway upgrade.
2. Spoke VNets MUST propagate to defaultRouteTable to advertise to ExpressRoute!
3. Prepend public 2-byte ASNs (<64496) only; never private or Azure-reserved ASNs.
4. Route Map summarization (Replace) strips AS_PATH and BGP Community attributes.

manual /24 prefix lists on CE routers!
CONTROL-PLANE BLOCK: Custom Hub Route Tables & Virtual WAN Routing Intent Are Mutually Exclusive!
1. Azure disables enabling Secured vHub Routing Intent whenever any custom route table (RT_PROD / RT_NONPROD) exists on the hub.
2. Even manual custom-RT static steering through an in-hub Azure Firewall collapses post-Firewall egress into defaultRouteTable.
3. Portal Route Tables apply one uniform 'Branches' propagation toggle across all ER circuits (per-connection prop is ARM/Preview CLI only).
Decision Rule: Need Routing Intent OR GA-supported identical on-premises prefixes? Deploy Pattern 1.D (Dual Secured Virtual WAN Hubs)!
